name: What tools are needed to install D-shaped cabinet handles?

mainEntity.name: What tools are needed to install D-shaped cabinet handles?

acceptedAnswer.text: To install D-shaped cabinet handles, you'll typically need a drill, drill bits appropriate for your cabinet material (usually 3/16" or 5mm), a tape measure, a pencil, and a screwdriver (Phillips or flathead, depending on the handle screws). A cabinet hardware jig or template can significantly improve accuracy and speed, especially when installing multiple handles. Safety glasses are also recommended during drilling.
acceptedAnswer.description: You'll need a drill, drill bits, tape measure, pencil, and screwdriver. A hardware jig is helpful for accuracy.
